questions.answer: Several options were provided by the host university, but you are free to not choose those and look elsewhere. I'll recommend choose one of them as they are pretty close to the campus and in the heart of the city so commuting is relatively inexpensive. The accomodations are a little expensive given the size of the room but the location makes up for it. And these accomodations are for exchnage students so you won't have difficuluty in making friends.
